engine: PDF.js 6.5.438 reviewed RGB snapshot with outward-rounded masks; pdf-lib 1.17.1 fresh image-only assembly
independentChecks: QPDF 12.3.2 JSON object/stream inspection and exact canonical-byte policy; Poppler 26.01.0 render/text/attachment checks, invoked in packaged Electron Node worker inside bubblewrap
supplementalChecks: Source rendering differences between PDF.js and Poppler are diagnostic. Candidate unmarked RGB must exactly match the reviewed PDF.js snapshot; this is independently checked from QPDF decoded image data.
runtimeChecks: strict independent input parse without repairs/password
independent output object and decoded-stream allowlist
exact canonical byte serialization with no unreachable objects/history/gaps/trailing payload
empty output text layer and no embedded attachments
exact black mask pixels and exact unmarked reviewed-snapshot RGB
known supported checker versions and no network
qualificationPending: Production case/approval gates are B2-B6 work; this profile does not enable publication.
Other OS/architectures and stronger power-loss guarantees require native qualification.
distribution: Fedora 44 ARM64 system prerequisites: qpdf, poppler-utils, bubblewrap, util-linux. No QPDF/Poppler binary is bundled, no runtime download; missing or unqualified tools block processing.
sourcePolicy: At most 8 renderable pages; no password protection or parser repairs; all source pages reviewed as fixed PDF.js snapshots. Image-only output loses text, tags, signatures and accessibility. No native originals, attachments, OCR, forms, actions or metadata are copied.
